Jindo Mix Potty Training: Why Does It Feel So Hard?

Jindo mixes aren't especially untrainable. They're smart and independent, so a steady routine and a good log matter more for them.

Commonly known Jindo mix traits

  • Smart and quick to learn, but independent. Without repetition, they tend to decide for themselves what to do
  • Very alert, so they can be sensitive to new places and people
  • Often said to prefer going potty outside

Potty training basics

  • Repeat at the same time and in the same place every day
  • Praise and reward right away when they get it right
  • After an accident, focus on setting them up to succeed next time instead of scolding

The tracking problem with dogs who prefer going outside

If your dog prefers to go outside, it's hard to tell at home whether they went, and only the person who took the walk knows. We cover this in more detail in How to track potty for a dog who only goes outside.

FAQ

Are Jindo mixes especially hard to potty train?

Not especially. Because they're smart and independent, a steady routine and repetition matter more for them than for other breeds.

Do Jindo mixes prefer to go outside?

Jindo-type dogs are often said to prefer going potty outside. It helps to make a habit of logging whether they went during walks.
